nodes.assessmentBasis: 原文最后按数列极限定义，对任意 ε>0 存在相应的 N，使所有 n≥N 的移位后绝对值小于 ε；该节点把这一存在性表述显式记录为中间结论。
nodes.proofTerm:
fun v_u_seq v_A_real hconv v_eps jjdep_n_exists_N_eps jjdep_n_shift_bound_all jjdep_n_eps_pos => by
  rcases jjdep_n_exists_N_eps with ⟨N, hN⟩
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hshift : ∀ m, m ≥ N → abs (((v_u_seq m) + (2 : ℝ)) - (v_A_real + (2 : ℝ))) = abs ((v_u_seq m) - v_A_real) := by
    intro m hm
    congr 1
    ring
  exact jjdep_n_shift_bound_all v_u_seq v_A_real hconv v_eps N hN hshift jjdep_n_eps_pos n hn

nodes.assessmentBasis: 原文最后根据数列极限的定义断言 uₙ+2→A+2。
nodes.proofTerm:
fun v_u_seq v_A_real hconv jjdep_n_exists_N_shift => by
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro v_eps hv_pos
  have hEps : ∃ N, ∀ n, n ≥ N → abs (v_u_seq n - v_A_real) < v_eps := by
    simpa [Real.dist_eq] using (Metric.tendsto_atTop.mp hconv v_eps hv_pos)
  rcases jjdep_n_exists_N_shift v_u_seq v_A_real hconv v_eps hEps
    (fun u A hconv0 eps N hN hshift hpos n hn => by
       rw [hshift n hn]
       exact hN n hn)
    hv_pos with ⟨N, hNshift⟩
  refine ⟨N, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  simpa [Real.dist_eq] using hNshift n hn
